s.note: the Kodiak Valley ski lodge, back in 1986
s.how: Rub a heavy pot with a halved garlic clove. Heat 300ml dry white wine until just simmering. Toss 200g grated gruyère and 200g grated emmental with 1 tbsp cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp kirsch or lemon juice and nutmeg. Keep warm over a burner and serve with 1 cubed baguette, 500g boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.

Heat the oven to 200C. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 100ml pizza sauce and scatter 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Place in a lined tin, bake 20 to 25 minutes and brush with 30g butter melted with 1 garlic clove. Warm 200ml marinara for dipping.

m.note: warming up at the lodge after a day on the slopes
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince in a heavy pot. Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then 2 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Stir in 800g tinned tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 45 minutes. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans for the last 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and crusty bread.

w.note: the snowy slopes of Kodiak Valley
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 180g butter. Whisk in 300g caster sugar, then 3 eggs one at a time until glossy. Fold in 100g plain flour, 30g cocoa and a pinch of salt. Pour into a lined 20 x 30cm tin and bake 25 minutes so the middle is still soft. Cool completely, cut into squares and dust heavily with icing sugar. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the Russian energy drink spilled on the hot tub controls
d.how: Simmer 80g sliced ginger with 100g sugar and 120ml water for 10 minutes, cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 30ml ginger syrup, 15ml lemon juice and 15ml lime juice to each, plus 30ml vodka if you like. Top with 180ml soda water, stir and add a lime wheel and mint sprig.
